from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashInflowRecord(BaseModel):
    """Operating cash inflow data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as written in the report")
    report_year: int | None = Field(description="Year the report covers")
    report_quarter: int | None = Field(description="Quarter in that year (1-4)")
    operating_cash_inflow: float | None = Field(description="Operating cash inflow amount for this period")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g., yuan, CNY)")
    comparison_previous_year: float | None = Field(description="Previous year's same period amount if provided in the report")
    statement_source: str | None = Field(description="Where in the report this comes from (e.g., 'Consolidated Cash Flow Statement')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line or excerpt containing the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_inflow_records: list[CashInflowRecord]
